title: Similar - Great Lakes River Flood Watch
goal: Analyze a provided Wisconsin gauge list for a spring high-water window, fetch stage observations, compare each station’s daily maximum stage against its flood threshold, and write `/root/output/river_watch_summary.json` with only stations that had flooding, including flood day counts and flood dates.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the source task’s core workflow: aggregate stage time series to daily maxima, compare against flood stage thresholds, and report stations with flood days. The changed region, time window, and JSON output keep it from being a simple rewrite while still making flood-detection the single critical skill.
